text: The service is a synthetic fixture with no production system and no customer data behind it, so containment and diagnostic actions carry no external blast radius.
source: meas-001: problem.md, the entire fixture definition, holds no hostname, URL, credential, connection string or dataset reference, and states the fixture is not backed by a production system.
cheapest_verification: Already performed by meas-001 against problem.md; no stronger check exists while problem.md is the only fixture artefact.
